Statement of work: data center cabling, phase 2

The companys existing fiber runs between racks 12 and 24 will be replaced by the vendor with OM4 cable during the weekend of November 21. Work will begin at 18:00 on Friday and must finish by 06:00 on Monday.

The vendor will label every cable at both ends and deliver an updated patch schedule within five business days of completion.
